Have you ever wondered how the CIA pulled off one of the greatest espionage operations in history? In this video, we explore the true story of Operation Ivy Bells, the top-secret CIA and U.S Navy mission to locate and wiretap an underwater communication cable serving a Soviet nuclear submarine base. Discover how the operation gave the United States a decade of invaluable intelligence on Soviet nuclear capabilities, until one NSA analyst betrayed their mission, and exposed one of the most remarkable espionage stories of the Cold War.
